evidence.title: AutoDev workflow and build documentation
evidence.locator: Download; Agent backends; Usage; Extending; Where state is stored
evidence.finding: Documents the Tauri/SolidJS desktop app, real external CLIs, optional worktrees, parallel sessions, local configuration and an optional autonomous coding loop. The download table describes Linux/macOS/Windows, with source-build instructions.

evidence.title: Exact built-in coding CLI specifications
evidence.finding: Built-in BackendSpec entries name actual claude, codex and agy executables and define their argument shapes. External models are not treated as additional coding harnesses.

evidence.title: Optional Pi backend specification
evidence.finding: A separate Pi specification launches the pi executable after the user copies the example into the backend directory. It is optional, not a bundled built-in entry.

evidence.title: PTY launch implementation
evidence.finding: Resolves the selected BackendSpec, builds its command in the requested directory and launches an independent native PTY process.

evidence.title: Product-owned headless entry point
evidence.finding: The autodev-headless binary delegates JSONL stdin/stdout handling to the product's headless module, without the GUI.

evidence.title: Desktop orchestration commands
evidence.finding: Tauri commands expose agent launch, persistent coding-loop state/advancement and local worktree merge. The existence of a command does not by itself establish a displayed diff review interface.

evidence.title: Product-owned loop state and role logic
evidence.locator: LoopRole/LoopPhase; LoopState; role prompts; grading and advancement
evidence.finding: The source separates decomposer/planner/generator/evaluator roles and retains feature/contract/progress state, a base commit, verification command and iteration bounds.

evidence.title: Git worktree and local merge implementation
evidence.locator: create_worktree lines57-63; diff/diff_since lines66-79; merge lines82-93
evidence.finding: Creates a distinct Git worktree/branch and can merge it into the current local branch, refusing a dirty target. This separates code checkouts and does not create a security sandbox.
